# format_parser v2.14.0 - Table of Contents

The owls are not what they seem

## Modules

- [FormatParser](https://format-parser.hexdocs.pm/FormatParser.md): FormatParser - A file format detection library for Elixir.

- [FormatParser.Audio](https://format-parser.hexdocs.pm/FormatParser.Audio.md): An Audio struct and functions.
- [FormatParser.Data](https://format-parser.hexdocs.pm/FormatParser.Data.md): A Data struct and functions for parsing data file formats.
- [FormatParser.Document](https://format-parser.hexdocs.pm/FormatParser.Document.md): A Document struct and functions.
- [FormatParser.Font](https://format-parser.hexdocs.pm/FormatParser.Font.md): A Font struct and functions.
- [FormatParser.Image](https://format-parser.hexdocs.pm/FormatParser.Image.md): An Image struct and functions.
- [FormatParser.Video](https://format-parser.hexdocs.pm/FormatParser.Video.md): A Video struct and functions.
